# Generated by westminster/tools/data/build_ideology.py - edit there.
# Scope: a character. Their ideology is a political one (not "Not Stated").
wm_ideo_is_political_trigger = {
	NOT = { faith = faith:wm_faith_not_stated }
}

# Scope: a seat (county title) with an MP. Its MP has a political ideology other than the seat's.
wm_ideo_seat_can_follow_mp_trigger = {
	holder = { wm_ideo_is_political_trigger = yes }
	NOT = { faith = holder.faith }
}

# Scope: a seat (county title) in Great Britain whose ideology isn't that of the party leading the polls.
wm_ideo_seat_can_follow_nation_trigger = {
	exists = global_var:wm_ideo_national_faith
	NOT = { faith = global_var:wm_ideo_national_faith }
	NOT = { any_this_title_or_de_jure_above = { this = title:k_northern_ireland } }
	NOT = { faith = faith:wm_faith_not_stated }
}
